params.caption: 🏆 League of Legends: New Dawn revealed — Riot's biggest overhaul lands in 2027 Riot Games used the stage of the 2026 World Championship Finals to unveil League of Legends: New Dawn with a debut trailer. The large-scale update is planned for 2027 and touches the game client, Summoner's Rift, the visuals and the gameplay itself. Riot frames it as the start of a new chapter for one of the world's biggest PC games. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 01:05 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN 👥 @riotgames · @LeagueOfLegends 🔥 React if you're hyped · 💬 What should Riot change first on the Rift? #LeagueOfLegends #NewDawn #RiotGames #Worlds2026 #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
